title: Union non-tax revenue (dividends & fees)
definition: Central government revenue receipts outside taxation—primarily surplus transfers from the Reserve Bank of India, dividends from public sector banks and enterprises, interest receipts, and economic service fees.

sources.title: RBI Bulletin — Union Budget 2025-26: An Assessment (Annex I)

points.evidence: RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I, row 'Non-tax Revenue', column 2022-23 (Actuals): 285 thousand crore INR (285,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I, row 'Non-tax Revenue', column 2023-24 (Actuals): 402 thousand crore INR (402,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I, row 'Non-tax Revenue', column 2024-25 (RE): 531 thousand crore INR (531,000 crore INR).
points.estimate_method: Compiled from official Union Budget documents (Revised Estimates / Budget Estimates) in RBI Bulletin.
